evidence.claim: MultiFocusing Imaging technology, which includes Common Offset MultiFocusing (COMF), Diffraction Imaging, and Azimuthal Refraction Statics, is featured on the Geomage Official Website.
The company's flagship processing suite, g-Platform, incorporates advanced Reverse Time Migration (RTM) and Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI) anisotropic depth migration modules.
According to the Geomage System Requirements, the software supports modern 64-bit computing architectures utilizing multi-core CPU threading and NVIDIA GPU cards with CUDA 11 support.
As documented in the Geomage g-Platform User Manual, intensive compute modules use a Seismic Distributed Loop module to manage batch processing and job deployment across remote CPU/GPU cluster nodes.
Reviewing the company's profile on Tracxn, Geomage operates purely as a software developer and service provider for upstream exploration rather than a physical data acquisition or data library owner.

While it does not own physical non-exclusive data libraries like asset-heavy peers, the software offers a multi-client capability with role-based access management as documented on Slashdot to host and process data securely for multiple external clients.
The g-Platform : Time imaging package contains designated processing modules required to process 2D, 3D, and 4D seismic datasets from raw field tapes through migration.

The platform's Refraction Statics and First-Break picking applications include specialized 4D Delaunay interpolation tracking and coordinate consistency terms optimized specifically for time-lapse (4D) processing projects.
The g-Space structural, geological, and geophysical interpretation software features built-in AI-assisted interpretation workflows to optimize subsurface characterization.
As shown in Geomage g-Space Video Documentation, these automated workflows facilitate accelerated horizon tracking, fault picking, and real-time structural modeling.

Geomage’s verified client list includes major global supermajors Shell and Total.
The company has deployed its advanced seismic processing software across more than 500 projects spanning 60+ countries for National Oil Companies and independent operators.
Geomage maintains structural offices and regional processing hubs in Modiin (Israel), Houston (United States), Mumbai (India), Beijing (China), and Belgrade (Serbia).

The company established a dedicated full-service processing center operation known as Geomage Imaging Services (GI) in Calgary, Alberta, to deliver turnkey MultiFocusing and diffraction imaging services.
PitchBook tracks Geomage Ltd. as a private enterprise currently in the "Generating Revenue" stage following secondary transaction activity.
Tracxn reports the company operates with a headcount tier of 51–200 employees, though concrete annual revenue growth percentages and backlog figures are kept strictly confidential.

Geomage maintains a strategic growth alliance with Novavente Limited (listed on the National Stock Exchange of India) to implement targeted outreach and data-driven marketing campaigns across the Indian and UK/US markets.

The company is an integrated user partner within the MVAPICH High Performance MPI Implementation consortium (hosted by Ohio State University) to support its parallel cluster and job management workflows.

Tracxn analytics ranks Geomage 50th among 114 active competitors in the seismic data imaging and processing software sector, placing it as a niche tier provider behind major public giants such as TGS and DUG.

The proprietary software platform (g-Platform and g-Space) holds market share focused heavily on macro-model-independent MultiFocusing technology deployed across hundreds of exploration sites globally.
